name: ALN-ANG3
sort_evidence: Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 lists ALN-ANG3 as an Alnylam-partnered RNAi therapeutic targeting ANGPTL3 in diabetic kidney disease, in Phase 2 NCT07271186 (recruiting).

trials.title: Study to Assess the Effects of ALN-ANG3 in Adult Participants With Diabetic Kidney Disease
A First In Human (FIH) Study to Learn if Different Doses of ALN-ANG3 Are Safe and Well Tolerated in Healthy Adults
